content: Sarar entehal edde dohon
Sarar boyoš ek šo hãtaiš bosor oil; hiba hetodin basi aššil.
Ar Kenan dešot Kiryat-Arbat (hiyan oilde, Hebronot) hibar moron oiye, ar Ibrahime Saralla handibolla edde šuk falon goribolla giye.
Bade Ibrahime hibar mora bouwor ḍakottu uiṭṭe edde Hetittiyo okkolor hãse zai hodde,
"Ãi tũwarar butore ekzon osin bidešitta; hoborstan banaibolla ãre tũwarar butore ekkan zaga beso, toi zene ãr sarme ãr mora bouwore dohon gorai fari."
Hetittiyo okkole Ibrahimore zuwabe hodde,

"Malik, ãrar hota funo, tũi ãrar butore ekzon Allar šoktišali neta. Ãrar hoborgunor butore he barik hoboror butore tũwar morare dohon gorogoi. Tũwar mora gãraibolla ãrar honokiye hitar hobor zaga sari dite ošikar no goribo."
Toi Ibrahime uṛiyore he dešor manuš mani Hetittiyo okkolor sarme mata niyuraiyore ijjot goijje.
Bade hibaye hitarare hodde, "Ãr morare ãr sarme dohon goraito diba iyan zodi tũwarar issa o, toile ãr hota funo, Soharor fut Efron loi ãlla ottor o,
toi zene hitar maṛor šeš šimat, Mokfelar gãt, ziba hitattu ase, hiba hite ãre de. Hite zene tũwarar sarme hiyanor fura dam loiyore hoborstan banaibolla ãr hãse besifele."
Ar Hetittiyo okkolor fũwati Efron o heṛe boiṛa aššil, ar Hetittiyo Efrone Ibrahimore zuwab dedde hiyan hitar šohor geiṛot góillede beggune funniye.
Hite hodde, "No, ãr malik, õne ãr hota funo, ãi ãr zatir manušor sarme he maṭ edde hiyanot ze gãt ase, hiba šoho ãi tũware dilam. Tũwar morare dohon gorogoi."
Hetunot Ibrahime abar dešor mainšor sarme mata niyuraiyore ijjot goijje.

Ar he dešor manuš beggunor sarme hibaye Efronore hodde, "Zodi mone ho foriyad gorir, tũi ãr hota funo, ãi maṛor dam di, meherbani gori tũi ãttu hingun goso, toi zene ãi ãr mora bouwore heṛe dohon goraifari."
Efrone Ibrahimore zuwabe hodde,
"Malik, ãr hota funo, he zagar dam oiyede sair šot rufar ṭĩya, kintu hin ãlla edde tũwalla hono kissu no, tũwar bouwore heṛe dohon gorogoi."
Ibrahime Efronor hota buzi faijje edde hite Hetittiyo okkolor sarme rufar ṭĩyar hota hoilde mozin, sair šot rufar ṭĩya šodor okkolor maf mozin mafiyore hitare diye.
Ei bafe Mamrer ḍake Mokfelat asede Efronor maṭ edde gãt, ar he maṛor sairo mikkar hár gas šoho,
hár Hetittiyo okkol hitar šohor geiṭor sarme goillilde hitarar sarme Ibrahimor šombotti šabbišṭo oiye.
Tarfore Ibrahime Kenan dešor Mamrer ḍake (ziyan Hebronot) Mokfelar maṛot asede gãtot hibar bou Sarare gãraiye.
Endilla gori he maṭ edde heṛe asede gãt hoborstan hisabe Hetittiyo okkolor hatottu Ibrahimor hãtot aišše.
